description: Full Medicare Care Compare profile of one hospice by ccn (or name and state): family caregiver survey star rating and the seven survey results (communication, timely help, respect, emotional support, help with pain and symptoms, rating 9 or 10, would recommend) against state and national averages, comprehensive assessment at admission, nurse or social worker visits in the last days of life, the Hospice Care Index score and its 10 indicators with national percentiles (live discharges, nursing visit gaps, nurse minutes, spending per beneficiary), average daily census, diagnosis mix, where care is given (home, assisted living, nursing facility) and ZIP codes served. A missing value carries the CMS footnote that explains it.

ccn.description: CMS certification number (6 characters, from the search tool). Preferred when known.

city.description: City of the agency office, to narrow a name lookup.

name.description: Agency name or part of it, used when no ccn is given.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, to narrow a name lookup.

name: hospice_ratings
title: Hospice ratings and quality measures
